raw_response: BNY Mellon described its ETF servicing business as showing "particular strength" that validated multiyear investments into these platforms. Specifically, for the period discussed (which includes data from 2024), ETF Assets Under Custody and Administration (AUCA) reached $2.8 trillion, representing an increase of over 60% year-over-year. Additionally, inflows into ETFs on BNY Mellon's platform outpaced the market.
